name: Signalcrest Beacon
purpose: Marketing landing page for the Beacon SaaS product: hero section, features, pricing tiers, FAQ, and an email signup form that stores leads.
actors: Visitor (anonymous; browses the landing page and can submit an email lead)
Operator (owns the site; reviews captured leads)

workflows.name: View landing page
workflows.description: Anonymous visitor loads the public root and sees hero, features, pricing tiers, and FAQ sections.

workflows.name: Sign up with email
workflows.description: Visitor submits an email and optional name in the signup form; a Lead is stored and a success state is shown.

workflows.name: Review leads
workflows.description: Operator views captured leads in a simple admin index.

seed_demo: Landing page content only: three pricing tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) with prices and feature lists, six features, six FAQ entries. No fake leads seeded.
